subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: May OpenClaw grant trusted keyed-state access to official ClawHub installs discovered as workspace-origin when the package identity, official catalog entry, install record, and resolved path all match?
rationale: The expected behavior follows the trusted official plugin contract, but the exact predicate controls a security boundary for persistent state and channel ingress APIs.

options.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
options.body: Trust only official ClawHub installs whose catalog identity, install record, and resolved install path match, while preserving denial for untracked workspace/load-path installs.

options.title: Hold for broader trust design
options.body: Keep this blocked behind the wider external-plugin keyed-state and container provenance discussion.

options.title: Reject expansion
options.body: Leave official ClawHub WhatsApp installs denied in this origin shape until they load through an already-trusted origin.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
recommendation.body: Trust only official ClawHub installs whose catalog identity, install record, and resolved install path match, while preserving denial for untracked workspace/load-path installs.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent trust-boundary history and already articulated the related official-plugin provenance policy.
